VlQkoux3_b0.title: The Stationmaster and the Clockwork Sparrow of Platform Nine

story_beats.speech: The ledger is gone again, leaving only an empty desk and the cold draft of midnight air chilling my weary old bones.
I heard a soft rhythmic clicking behind the rafters and spotted a tiny brass bird clutching my precious leather bound logbook tightly.
I realized the bird was not stealing my work but repairing the rusted gears of the station clock hidden inside the wall panels.
As the station bell chimed perfectly, the little sparrow settled on my shoulder, our partnership finally bringing peace back to this lonely place.

rayvan-gemini-ed365c573c8c2d479669.title: The Conductor of the Whispering Platform

story_beats.speech: Another crate missing from the platform, yet the security cameras show absolutely nothing but empty tracks and shadows moving across the cold concrete.
Wait, a small tabby cat is nudging that loose floorboard near the maintenance hatch, perhaps hiding something important beneath the dusty old station floorboards today.
The cat triggered a concealed lever, causing the entire wall to slide open and reveal a secret compartment used by the sneaky station baggage porters.
With the mystery finally solved, the cat curls up on my desk, purring loudly as we prepare for the morning express train to arrive safely.
